sentiment_score_definition: x <= -0.35: Bearish; -0.35 < x <= -0.15: Somewhat-Bearish; -0.15 < x < 0.15: Neutral; 0.15 <= x < 0.35: Somewhat_Bullish; x >= 0.35: Bullish
relevance_score_definition: 0 < x <= 1, with a higher score indicating higher relevance.

feed.title: Press Release: Vitalist Reports First Quarter 2027 Financial Results
feed.summary: Vitalist has released its financial results for the first quarter of 2027. This press release provides a detailed overview of the company's performance during this period. The report will include key financial metrics and highlights from the quarter.

feed.title: Ashburn homeowners say fighting a Dominion power line could cost them hundreds of thousands of dollars
feed.summary: This article discusses the financial burden homeowners in Ashburn are facing as they fight against a proposed Dominion power line. The costs associated with legal battles and expert consultations could amount to hundreds of thousands of dollars, placing significant strain on the residents.

feed.title: One year after protest, organizers say Microsoft still needs to cut ties with Israeli military
feed.summary: One year after protests began, organizers are continuing to demand that Microsoft sever all ties with the Israeli military, alleging the company's technology was used for mass surveillance in Gaza. While Microsoft did cut some cloud services to an Israeli military unit following earlier protests, activists like Hossam Nasr and Ahmed Shahrour believe more action is needed. Microsoft stated it has investigated the allegations and implemented new internal reporting processes for concerns about technology deployment.

feed.title: Steel Dynamics stock falls on tariff pressure and valuation
feed.summary: Steel Dynamics stock experienced a significant drop due to pressure from tariff headlines, which suggested a potential cut in import tariffs on Canadian steel and aluminum. Despite a strong year-to-date performance, the stock's valuation is considered high, with its current price exceeding a cited fair value. Analyst consensus, however, remains moderately positive with an average target price suggesting an upside.

feed.title: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP Urges First Solar, Inc. (NASDAQ: FSLR) Investors to Seek Counsel Before August 24, 2026 Lead Plaintiff Deadline in the Securities Class Action
feed.summary: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP is reminding investors of First Solar, Inc. (NASDAQ: FSLR) to seek counsel before the August 24, 2026 lead plaintiff deadline in a federal securities class action. The lawsuit alleges that First Solar made false or misleading statements regarding its capacity to manage the impact of U.S. tariff policy and understated the negative impact of its responses to this policy on its projected 2026 fiscal year performance. Investors who purchased First Solar securities between February 26, 2025, and February 24, 2026, are encouraged to contact the law firm to discuss their options.

feed.title: FedEx declares $1.22 quarterly dividend per share
feed.summary: FedEx Corp. (NYSE: FDX) has announced that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $1.22 per share on common stock. This dividend is scheduled for payment on October 1, 2026, to shareholders recorded as of the close of business on September 14, 2026. FedEx, a global provider of transportation and e-commerce services, reported annual revenue of $86 billion and employs over 450,000 people.

feed.title: How the J&J Institute Provides Surgery Training for HCPs
feed.summary: The Johnson & Johnson Institute offers comprehensive surgical training for healthcare professionals (HCPs), combining online modules, in-person programs, and partnerships with surgical training centers. Since 1992, the Institute has evolved to provide state-of-the-art education, focusing on safe and effective use of advanced surgical tools and technologies. Key programs like SuturED, HemostasisED, Energy Academy, Stapling Academy, and the Future Leaders program equip HCPs with essential skills and ongoing professional development.

feed.title: Garmin stock holds after Q2 revenue tops estimates
feed.summary: Garmin stock remains steady after reporting better-than-expected Q2 revenue of $2.02 billion, surpassing the $1.93 billion estimate, and providing strong full-year 2026 revenue guidance of $8.05 billion. The company's pro forma EPS guidance of $10 also exceeds the $9.67 consensus. This performance underscores Garmin's continued expansion and premium earnings profile, reinforcing its position as a stable large-cap consumer technology company.

feed.title: Morgan Stanley sees India steel stocks continuing gains
feed.summary: Morgan Stanley reported that Indian hot-rolled coil prices increased by about 1% week-over-week, reaching Rs58,500 per ton, and secondary rebar prices climbed approximately 2% to Rs45,400 per ton. Despite recent import increases and potential near-term weakness during the monsoon season, the bank maintains a positive medium-term outlook on steel prices and spreads due to government support, supply-demand balance, and China’s anti-involution measures. Steel stocks have gained 8% year-to-date, contrasting with the Sensex’s 9% decline.

feed.title: Microchip Technology (NASDAQ:MCHP) Earns Outperform Rating from Analysts at BMO Capital Markets
feed.summary: BMO Capital Markets initiated coverage on Microchip Technology (NASDAQ:MCHP) with an "outperform" rating and a $95 price target, suggesting a 25% upside. This positive outlook aligns with a broader "Moderate Buy" consensus and an average price target of $98.67 from other analysts. The company recently surpassed quarterly earnings and revenue expectations, though insider selling of shares was noted in the last quarter.

feed.title: CAMX | Cambiar Aggressive Value ETF Stock Data, Price & News

feed.title: Disney Advertising & United Airlines Take ESPN Fantasy Football to New Heights: This Year's Televised Draft Event Includes Live Picks from 35,000 Feet on Flight Powered by Starlink Wi-Fi
feed.summary: Disney Advertising and United Airlines are collaborating to bring a unique experience to ESPN Fantasy Football by having a live draft pick made from 35,000 feet on a United flight equipped with Starlink Wi-Fi. This event, featuring ESPN host Tyler Fulghum, aims to showcase the reliability of inflight Wi-Fi and will be part of the 2026 ESPN Fantasy Football Draft broadcast on August 25. The initiative highlights how United's Starlink Wi-Fi allows travelers to stay connected to important events, even while flying.

feed.title: Abbott Laboratories settles multitude of infant formula legal claims
feed.summary: Abbott Laboratories has settled approximately 2,000 legal cases related to its infant formula causing necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC) in premature babies, paying around $670 million. The settlement includes the Gill family's case, which previously resulted in a $500 million award. Abbott maintains that the settlements are a compromise of disputed claims and not an admission of liability, asserting confidence in the safety of its products while acknowledging roughly 1,700 lawsuits involving 12,700 infants are still pending.

feed.title: Analysts Offer Insights on Consumer Cyclical Companies: Ford Motor (F), Geely Automobile Holdings (OtherGELYF) and Norwegian Cruise Line (NCLH)
feed.summary: Analysts have provided insights into several consumer cyclical companies, including Ford Motor, Geely Automobile Holdings, and Norwegian Cruise Line. Morgan Stanley maintained a Hold rating for Ford with a $14.00 price target, while Jefferies reiterated a Buy rating for Geely with a HK$32.80 target. Argus Research kept a Hold rating on Norwegian Cruise Line, which also saw a downgrade to Hold by Mizuho Securities.

feed.title: Essex Property Trust stock holds firm after a $4.08 EPS beat
feed.summary: Essex Property Trust (ESS) reported a Q2 2026 EPS of $4.08 on $489.05 million in revenue, surpassing consensus estimates. The company provided Q3 2026 guidance of $3.930-$4.050 EPS and full-year guidance of $16.030-$16.250 EPS. The stock traded at $288.17, reflecting a stable operating story and a focus on execution for the remainder of the year.

feed.title: FedEx Corp. Board Declares Quarterly Dividend
feed.summary: FedEx Corp.'s Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $1.22 per share on its common stock, reinforcing its commitment to stockholder value. The dividend is scheduled for payment on October 1, 2026, to shareholders recorded by September 14, 2026. FedEx, a global leader in transportation and e-commerce with $86 billion in annual revenue, also highlighted its goal to achieve carbon-neutral operations by 2040.

feed.title: Four Days Left To Buy Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE:CCS) Before The Ex-Dividend Date
feed.summary: Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE:CCS) is set to trade ex-dividend shortly, with a US$0.32 per share dividend payable on September 9th. While the company's dividend is covered by profits (27% payout ratio), its free cash flow payout of 91% is high, and earnings per share have declined by 5.3% annually over the last five years. This raises concerns about the long-term sustainability and attractiveness of the stock for dividend investors, despite a 16% average annual dividend increase over the same period.

feed.title: Kaos Capital pushes for board changes at Capricor Therapeutics
feed.summary: Kaos Capital Ltd., a shareholder in Capricor Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ:CAPR), is demanding immediate board changes, including the nomination of two independent directors and the formation of an M&A and Strategic Alternatives Committee. The investment firm is pushing for a cash preservation plan, citing a significant decrease in Capricor's cash reserves and increased operating expenses. Kaos Capital also highlighted various legal issues faced by Capricor and is prepared to seek shareholder support if their demands are not met.

feed.title: GRS extends Wells Fargo facility by £30m to fund infrastructure push
feed.summary: GRS Group has secured an additional £30 million in financing from Wells Fargo Capital Finance, extending their banking facility for five years until 2031. This funding aims to support GRS's investments in infrastructure, digitalization, circular materials, and supply-chain growth. The deal provides GRS with increased financial stability and flexibility to manage the substantial working capital required for major infrastructure projects, particularly in the UK's growing pipeline of water, rail, highways, and energy projects.

feed.title: Resilient News Corp stock holds above $29 as fresh earnings beat lifts outlook
feed.summary: News Corp's stock is trading above $29 after a strong fiscal Q4 2026 earnings report, which saw revenue increase by 10.8% to $2.34 billion and adjusted EPS beat consensus estimates at $0.35. This performance has led to a more positive outlook for the company, with analysts' average target price suggesting further upside potential. The company's ongoing $1 billion share repurchase program further underscores its commitment to capital return and investor value.

feed.title: Waters stock hovers near 52-week high as Q2 2026 beat supports upbeat guidance
feed.summary: Waters Corporation's stock is trading near a 52-week high following a strong Q2 2026 earnings beat and optimistic full-year guidance, indicating robust demand for its analytical instruments. The company reported adjusted earnings of $3.05 per share and revenue of $1.64 billion, exceeding analyst expectations. Waters also provided confident guidance for Q3 and the full year 2026, with analysts maintaining a "moderate buy" rating.

feed.title: TPG Mortgage Investment Trust To Acquire Cherry Hill For $117.5 Million At 29% Premium
feed.summary: TPG Mortgage Investment Trust is set to acquire Cherry Hill Mortgage Investment Corporation for an implied value of approximately $117.5 million, creating a larger residential mortgage REIT with a combined investment portfolio of $9 billion. Cherry Hill shareholders will receive 0.3063 shares of MITT common stock plus $0.93 in cash per share, representing a 29% premium. The merger, expected to close in Q4 2026, aims to increase MITT's scale, improve operating efficiency, and achieve $7 million to $9 million in annual operating efficiencies.

feed.title: Essity To Acquire Kenvue’s Brazil Feminine Care Business For $284 Million
feed.summary: Essity has agreed to acquire Kenvue’s feminine care business in Brazil for $284 million, a move that strengthens Essity's presence in one of the world's largest feminine care markets. The acquisition includes popular brands like Carefree, Sempre Livre, and o.b., along with related manufacturing assets. This deal aligns with Essity’s strategy to expand in high-growth categories and markets, building on its existing strong position in Brazil's hygiene and health sector.

feed.title: Uber, ServiceNow And A Health Care Stock On CNBC’s ‘Final Trades’
feed.summary: On CNBC's "Halftime Report Final Trades," experts recommended ServiceNow, Vertex Pharmaceuticals, and Uber Technologies. ServiceNow was highlighted for its expanded partnership with Tech Mahindra on AI projects. Vertex Pharmaceuticals was noted for its strong Q2 earnings and raised FY2026 sales guidance, while Uber was featured for launching fully driverless Apollo Go robotaxis in Dubai with Baidu.

feed.title: Prudential Financial, Inc. to Participate in 2026 Barclays Global Financial Services Conference; Live Webcast Available
feed.summary: Prudential Financial, Inc. (NYSE: PRU) announced its participation in the 2026 Barclays Global Financial Services Conference on Wednesday, September 16, 2026. CFO Yanela Frias will engage in an analyst-led fireside chat at approximately 9:45 a.m. ET. A live audio webcast will be available on the company's investor relations website, with a replay accessible until September 30, 2026.

The transaction occurred on August 20, 2026, with the stock trading at $1,075.5 per share. InvestingPro analysis suggests the stock, which has surged 43% year-to-date, may be overvalued.

feed.title: What Are Wall Street Analysts' Target Price for J. M. Smucker Stock?
feed.summary: J. M. Smucker Company (SJM) has seen its shares underperform the broader S&P 500 over the past year, gaining 8.9% compared to the S&P 500's 19.5%. However, SJM has outperformed the S&P 500 and the First Trust Nasdaq Food & Beverage ETF in 2026 year-to-date, rising 25.8%. Despite mixed performance due to profitability headwinds from rising commodity costs and interest expenses, analysts hold a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating for SJM with a mean price target of $128.06.

feed.title: H&R REIT To Be Acquired In C$6.7 Billion Deal By GO Residential REIT And Consortium Including Blackstone, Crestpoint And PSP
feed.summary: H&R Real Estate Investment Trust has agreed to be acquired in a C$6.7 billion deal by GO Residential REIT and a consortium including Blackstone, Crestpoint, and PSP Investments. The transaction, expected to close in Q4 2026, values H&R units at C$12.01, representing a 14.5% premium. This acquisition will establish GO REIT as a leading luxury residential REIT with an expanded portfolio of 35 properties and over 13,300 residential suites across eight markets and four states.

feed.title: Parker-Hannifin Corporation (NYSE:PH) Plans Quarterly Dividend of $2.00
feed.summary: Parker-Hannifin Corporation (NYSE:PH) has declared a quarterly dividend of $2.00 per share, payable on September 11 to shareholders of record on August 31. This dividend represents an annualized payment of $8.00 per share, yielding approximately 0.8%, and marks the 70th consecutive year of annual dividend increases for the company. Parker-Hannifin's strong financial performance, with recent earnings and revenue exceeding expectations and a low payout ratio, supports this dividend, while analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" consensus with an average price target of $1,100.

feed.title: Fortive Corporation (NYSE:FTV) Announces Dividend Increase - $0.07 Per Share
feed.summary: Fortive Corporation (NYSE:FTV) has announced a 16.7% increase in its quarterly dividend, raising it to $0.07 per share from $0.06. This dividend, payable on September 25 to shareholders of record on September 4, represents an annualized dividend of $0.28 and a 0.5% yield. The company recently surpassed earnings and revenue estimates and authorized repurchases of up to 20 million shares, indicating a strong financial position to support the increased dividend.

feed.title: Fifth Third Commences Registered Exchange Offer to Register Up to $1.27B of Senior Notes
feed.summary: Fifth Third Bancorp has initiated a registered exchange offer to convert up to $1.27 billion of its outstanding unregistered senior notes into identical registered notes. This offer includes 4.000% senior notes due 2029 and 5.982% fixed-to-floating notes due 2030, which will become free of transfer restrictions. The exchange offer is set to expire on September 22, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. NYC time.

feed.title: Zacks Research Upgrades Darling Ingredients (NYSE:DAR) to "Strong-Buy"
feed.summary: Zacks Research has upgraded Darling Ingredients (NYSE:DAR) to a "Strong-Buy" rating from "Hold." This upgrade comes as the company reported strong quarterly earnings, beating analyst estimates with $2.41 EPS and a 16.4% year-over-year revenue increase to $1.72 billion. feed.summary: Zacks Research has downgraded Canadian Natural Resources (NYSE:CNQ) from a "strong-buy" to a "hold" rating, though the overall analyst consensus remains a "Moderate Buy" with an average price target of $57. The company recently reported strong quarterly earnings of $1.58 EPS, beating estimates, and revenue of $14.74 billion, significantly exceeding expectations. CNQ's stock opened at $51.04, close to its 52-week high, and institutional investors hold a substantial 74.03% stake in the company.

feed.title: Zacks Research Upgrades Alexandria Real Estate Equities (NYSE:ARE) to "Hold"
feed.summary: Zacks Research has upgraded Alexandria Real Estate Equities (NYSE:ARE) from a "strong sell" to a "hold" rating, despite a consensus "Reduce" rating and a target price of $52.38 from other analysts. The company recently reported a significant EPS miss and a 13% year-over-year revenue decline. Insider trading activity was mixed, with the CFO selling shares and the Chairman purchasing shares, while institutional investors hold a substantial portion of the stock.

feed.title: CytomX Therapeutics (NASDAQ:CTMX) Downgraded to "Hold" Rating by Zacks Research

Despite this, institutional investors have increased their holdings in the company, collectively owning 67.77% of the stock.

feed.summary: The Blackstone Long Short Credit Income Fund (NYSE: BGX) is expected to pay a monthly dividend of 0.08 USD. Investors need to purchase shares before August 24 to be eligible for this dividend. The fund currently has a trailing twelve-month dividend yield of 9.55%.

feed.title: Chagee Q2FY26 Results: Company to report earnings on August 28

A conference call will follow at 8:00 am U.S. Eastern Time on the same day for investors to discuss the results with management. Participants need to register in advance to receive dial-in details and can submit questions via email up to 24 hours prior to the call.

feed.title: Xylem appoints Andrea van der Berg as New Chief Financial Officer
feed.summary: Xylem (NYSE: XYL) has announced the appointment of Andrea van der Berg as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, effective September 1, 2026. She will succeed William “Bill” Grogan, who is departing for another professional opportunity. Van der Berg previously served as Senior Vice President, Finance, for Xylem’s Water Infrastructure segment and brings over two decades of finance and business leadership experience.

feed.title: Australia's Steadfast to be acquired by KKR-led group for $5.5B (KKR:NYSE)
feed.summary: An investor group led by KKR and Dragoneer Investment Group, along with Amwins Group, has agreed to acquire the Australian insurance company Steadfast Group. The acquisition is valued at approximately A$7.7 billion (US$5.5 billion). This deal highlights significant private equity investment in the insurance sector.

feed.title: Analysts’ Opinions Are Mixed on These Financial Stocks: Willis Towers Watson (WTW) and Raymond James Financial (RJF)
feed.summary: Analysts have provided mixed opinions on Willis Towers Watson (WTW) and Raymond James Financial (RJF). TD Cowen analyst Andrew Kligerman maintained a Buy rating for Willis Towers Watson with a $455.00 price target, while the overall consensus for WTW is a Moderate Buy. For Raymond James Financial, TD Cowen analyst William Katz maintained a Hold rating with a $161.00 price target, though the general Street consensus is a Moderate Buy for RJF.

feed.title: Oracle Sits Far Below Wall Street’s Target. Here’s What Gets It There.
feed.summary: Oracle (ORCL) is currently trading significantly below Wall Street's consensus target of $246.43, despite strong growth in its cloud business and a massive $638 billion in remaining performance obligations. The stock has been hit by a negative free cash flow due to heavy AI capital expenditures and concerns about customer concentration in its large AI contracts. The article highlights key checkpoints, such as RPO conversion and OCI margins, that need to materialize for Oracle to reach its target price, with the next earnings report being a crucial factor.

feed.title: REG - Smith & Nephew Plc Bank of America Corp - Holding(s) in Company
feed.summary: Bank of America Corporation has filed a TR-1 notification indicating a change in its major holdings in Smith & Nephew Plc. The filing shows that Bank of America's total voting rights in Smith & Nephew Plc, including through financial instruments, changed to 2.888834% as of August 19, 2026, down from a previous position of 3.172736%. The notification details direct voting rights and various financial instruments like swaps and a put option.

feed.title: Air Products stock draws activist interest as investors weigh currency and earnings headwinds
feed.summary: Air Products & Chemicals Inc. is experiencing renewed activist investor interest, with a significant stake reported, indicating potential for value creation through strategic adjustments. Concurrently, the company faces currency headwinds, projected to negatively impact fiscal 2026 earnings by 3%. Investors are balancing the long-term growth opportunities in industrial gases and hydrogen with these short-term macro factors.

feed.title: Morgan Stanley Remains a Buy on Halliburton (HAL)
feed.summary: Morgan Stanley analyst Joe Laetsch maintained a Buy rating on Halliburton (HAL) with a price target of $40.00. Laetsch, who covers the Energy sector, has a 7.6% average return and a 62.99% success rate on his stock recommendations. feed.title: Parker-Hannifin Corp FY 2026: Revenue $21.5B, EPS $28.48— 10-K Summary
feed.summary: Parker-Hannifin Corp reported strong full-year 2026 results with revenue of $21.5 billion, an 8.3% increase year-over-year, and diluted EPS of $28.48, up 5%. The company's backlog also increased, indicating continued demand.
